material.acceptance_criteria: gm.wait({ms:N}) replies only after about N ms have elapsed, and waited_ms equals the measured elapsed time.
material.description: gm.wait({ms:600000}) answered completed:true with waited_ms:600000 about 17 s after the previous dispatch. Six such waits spanned about 190 s by dispatch id, so a caller polling lanes with wait spins without a real delay. Fix: block for the requested duration before replying, and report the measured elapsed time as waited_ms. Found by drain-gm-4 while waiting on row lanes.
material.subject: gm wait verb returns at once while reporting waited_ms
material.witness: wait {ms:3000} from cwd oscraft, session verify-gm-wait-verb-returns-immediately: wall 3410 ms, waited_ms 3000
material.witness_plan: From session verify-gm-wait-verb-returns-immediately: read the clock before and after gm.wait({ms:60000}); the gap must be at least 60 s, and waited_ms must match it.
